caption: The drawing depicts a carved statue of a standing human figure positioned on a two-tiered rectangular base. The figure has long dark hair, brown skin, and is wearing a knee-length garment with a red bodice, rose-colored sleeves, a green neckline, a multi-colored scalloped lower hem in yellow, green, and orange, and a yellow mantle draped over one shoulder and held at the waist. The figure has visible facial features including eyes, nose, lips, and ears, and appears to be looking to the observer's left. The person’s feet are clad in red shoes, and both arms are bent: one hand rests on the chest and the other hangs down at the side. The statue is rendered in shades of red, yellow, brown, green, and black. The base is depicted in solid grayish tones. The plain background is light beige without any additional objects or decorations.
title: Cigar Store Indian
